hero.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal
hero.description: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors awaited key inflation and spending data during a holiday-shortened week.

latest.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal
latest.description: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors awaited key inflation and spending data during a holiday-shortened week.

latest.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
latest.description: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

latest.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
latest.description: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

latest.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
latest.description: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.

latest.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter
latest.description: Data shows that the ten busiest accounts accounted for more than all of the exchange's quarterly growth, while trading by everyone else declined.

latest.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
latest.description: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.

latest.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
latest.description: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

latest.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
latest.description: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

latest.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
latest.description: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

latest.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
latest.description: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

latest.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
latest.description: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.

latest.title: China’s Xiamen Airlines to buy 50 Boeing jets in $7.4 billion deal
latest.description: Xiamen Airlines has agreed to purchase 50 Boeing 737-8 aircraft with a combined catalog price of around $7.4 billion.

latest.title: SoftBank drops 15% as Wall Street AI sell-off ripples across Asian tech names
latest.description: Asian technology stocks tumbled Wednesday, led by a rout in Japanese semiconductor stocks, as renewed concerns over the artificial intelligence trade rattled investors.

latest.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
latest.description: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.

latest.title: U.S. jury convicts Huawei in a criminal trial over fraud and trade secrets
latest.description: Huawei was found guilty of bank fraud, money laundering and trade secret theft conspiracy in a U.S. trial.

latest.title: Houthi attack on Saudi Arabian sovereign wealth fund PIF's tower injures 11
latest.description: This has been the second attack by the Iran-backed group in six days on the tower, although the previous attack did not cause any casualties.

latest.title: Trump open to pardoning Jensen Huang if needed: NY Post
latest.description: Trump said he would be willing to pardon Jensen Huang if needed and argued that the Nvidia CEO should not have to invoke the Fifth Amendment before Congress.

latest.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
latest.description: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

latest.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia return shows the U.S.-China AI race is about more than chips
latest.description: Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO demonstrates that the U.S.-China artificial intelligence race is not just about semiconductors, but tech talent too.
